card.name: Last digit of p-values, and 'or as'
card.fires_on: The final digit (5 or 1) of a p-value such as p<0.05 or p<.0001, and less often the word 'as' or 'even' right after 'or' in dose ranges. Also a leading '1' in numeric tables.

modes.label: Digit 1 in number tables
modes.description: A leading 1 at the start of a number in tabular data.
